period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis, from First Security Islami Bank PLC's own Condensed Balance Sheet (Un-audited) as at 2018-06-30. Income-statement items with a '_cumulative' suffix are cumulative from 1 January of the same year; items with a '_discrete_q' suffix are the single discrete quarter alone -- both are printed directly as separate columns in the source document (not derived by subtraction), so both carry basis='reported'. Sourced via the Wayback Machine. NOTE -- small comparative discrepancy (not a parsing error, both figures internally validate): this filing's own comparative 31-Dec-2017 Total Assets column (343,739,479,294) is -100.00% LOWER than this dataset's already-stored 2017_Q4.json total_assets figure (344,486.61mn). The stored 2017_Q4 figure was sourced from a later annual report's multi-year 'Five-Year Summary'/Annexure table (per this bank's own sources.json, which already documents a ~0.1-0.2% internal inconsistency within that same summary table between Total Assets and Total Liabilities+Equity), whereas this interim filing's comparative column is drawn directly from the primary, contemporaneous Balance Sheet as originally published shortly after 2017 year-end. Per this dataset's 'prefer contemporaneous over later-restated' convention, this is recorded here verbatim rather than reconciled; the existing 2017_Q4.json file is NOT modified. Not crisis-related -- a pre-existing small classification/rounding difference in the bank's own summary tables. This report already includes BOTH a Jan-June cumulative column AND a separate Apr-June discrete-quarter column (headed 'Jan-June' and 'Apr-June' with a hyphen rather than the word 'to' used in later years' headers) -- both captured here with '_cumulative' and '_discrete_q' suffixes. This is the joint-earliest year in this bank's archive where a discrete quarterly breakout is available.

Investment / Deposit (calculated: Total Investment / Deposits and Other Accounts)
line_items.metric_note: Simple Investment/Deposit calculation per this dataset's standard formula (methodology.md). This does NOT match the bank's own regulatory-basis 'Investment Deposit Ratio' as separately disclosed in annual reports (e.g. FY2024 annual reports 122.25% vs this simple calculation giving ~141% at FY2024 year-end) -- the bank's own regulatory ratio evidently uses a different deposit/investment base (e.g. including borrowings or a regulatory-defined denominator) not disclosed in these condensed interim statements. Recorded as a internally-consistent, comparable-across-quarters proxy, not as a reproduction of the bank's own regulatory ratio.
